name: Crash 'N' Dance
summary: A party is hitting The Wumpa Islands - AND YOU'RE INVITED! Get ready to dance your jorts off in this brand new and N.Tense rhythm game set in the beloved Crash Bandicoot Universe! Bust all kinds of moves across 12 familiar worlds by hitting the right key at the right time inside the rings - but watch out! don't let distractions throw you off balance!
